subject: Exec asks prioritization matrix & open decisions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Holden <sara@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec asks prioritization matrix & open decisions

Team — attaching the first cut of the exec-asks prioritization matrix ahead of Monday's QBR prep slot. This is meant to be a compact tracker for the cross-functional items that have been surfaced to execs in the last 6 weeks and need clarity before the QBR: owners, ask, outcome requested by execs, blocker, and a suggested severity.

Quick ask: please review and update the "owner update" column directly in the sheet by EOD Monday. I captured items from product, sales, and ops that surfaced in last week's syncs. Key areas where we need decisions:
- Cache eviction policy for Dedicated (impact: latency SLOs) — exec wants a go/no-go on the proposed KV TTL change.
- Redaction window for Private deployments — legal asked for confirmation of retention window to include in SOC attestation.
- Pricing floor for reserved capacity — finance wants confirmation of minimum commit tiers for Dedicated.

I'm copying Sara from Acme; they flagged two items under the "integration" row that could move to canary at lower risk if we grant a temporary allowance (see matrix row 7).

Attachments: exec_asks_prioritization_matrix_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Proposed meeting cadence this week: 30-min sync Tuesday 9:30am PT to lock decisions we need to present at QBR. If your item needs more time, mark it and add a 1-1 note in the sheet.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Holden <sara@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec asks prioritization matrix & open decisions

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together. Quick updates filled into the sheet (rows 2, 4, 7):
- Dedicated cache TTL: Engineering ops recommends a staged rollout (canary + metrics gate) instead of a full flip; put a medium risk flag.
- Private retention window: Legal requested a short follow-up; I uploaded the notes from the last compliance call (attachment: acme_qbr_prep_notes.pdf) and added the legal contact (Rachel K.).
- Pricing floor: Finance asked for two scenarios (base + promotional) by Wed. I've added the finance contact and a short rationale in row 5.

Sara — on the integration allowance: can you confirm if Acme can accept the canary restrictions (1 region, limited throughput) for an initial 30-day trial? If yes, we'll mark the integration as conditional go.

Small ask for the team: please flag items that are "decision only" vs "decision + implementation" — that'll help the exec deck (we're trying to aim for 6 decision-only items max).

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: acme_qbr_prep_notes.pdf (PDF; redacted)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec asks prioritization matrix & open decisions

Thanks — reviewed and added risk/rollback notes inline (sheet). A couple of clarifications and proposals:
1) Cache TTL (row 2): propose a metrics gate: 99th-percentile latency and mem pressure thresholds. If we hit either, auto-roll back. This lets us meet the exec ask for cost/efficiency while preserving SLOs.
2) Private retention (row 4): legal's ask narrows the window to 90 days for audit logs; ops says this is feasible but requires a schema migration for archived logs. Cost estimate added (sheet cell F4).
3) Pricing floor (row 5): propose we present two options at QBR — conservative (no change) and aggressive (introduce a 3-month promotional band for new customers). Finance will need to sign off.

I've created a short Trello/board snapshot for the meeting and linked it in the sheet under "meeting artifacts." Can we lock Tuesday 9:30am PT? If that doesn't work for execs, I can shift to 1pm PT.

Vivek
Head of Reliability & Ops
Redwood Inference

Acked and updated two blockers in the sheet (rows 2 & 7). Quick notes:
- Row 2 (cache TTL): need a short perf benchmark run on the smaller model set (aim to complete today) so we can quantify the 99th pct hit.
- Row 7 (Acme integration): Sara — we can accept the canary constraints; Marissa, I'll draft the integration runbook and send a diff to your inbox by EOD.

I can take the Tuesday 9:30am PT slot. If we expect execs to ask detailed infra questions, recommend we have a 15-min pre-brief at 9:00am PT for ops/product to align on phrasing.

Jonas
